scope: Canonical A1 full-production q^-4 Gaussian on the fixed L=16 three-torus, six real coordinates for three complex components, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, embedded Pauli generators, exact spectral convolution, and the declared common symmetry-preserving multiplier class. Counterterm and bare-concentration follow-ups are reviewed separately at fixed production coefficients.

theorem_boundary.field_regularities: X belongs almost surely to C^(1/2-kappa) for every kappa>0; partial_i X belongs to C^(-1/2-kappa)
theorem_boundary.canonical_lift: K_A is the geometric/Stratonovich reconstruction of omega_A(X) partial_i X from the canonical Gaussian second level X^a circle partial_i X^b
theorem_boundary.convergence: For every finite p and kappa>0, admissible common-even approximations converge in L^p(Omega; C^(-1/2-kappa)); dyadic subsequences converge almost surely
theorem_boundary.zero_K_counterterm: E[X^a_Lambda partial_i X^b_Lambda]=partial_i C_Lambda^{ab}(0)=0 for every common real-even regulator
theorem_boundary.scheme_boundary: The limit is independent within the declared common-even scalar class; component-split asymmetric approximations may carry an area/drift anomaly
theorem_boundary.energy_boundary: The lift defines K_A only. It does not define J_A*K_A, |K_A|^2, or the Class-II Gibbs energy.

admissible_regulators: common real-even scalar Fourier multipliers on all six real components, uniformly bounded, converging pointwise to one, with compact spectral support or a uniform Schwartz tail; nonlinear products use exact Fourier convolution or sufficient de-aliasing

analytic_split.counterterm_bounds: With s=|Psi_1|^2+|Psi_2|^2 and positive Q_II, 9*lambda_min(Q_II)*s <= W_eps(Psi) <= 9*(a+2b+c)*s, so W_eps=0 iff s=0.
analytic_split.naive_subtraction_no_go: For F_N^naive=F_core+F_II,N-delta_cube*N*int W_eps, homogeneous first-two-component fields have F_II,N=0 and yield amplitude Theta(N^(1/4)) with infimum at most -c*N^(3/2); fixed lower-order coefficients therefore have no cutoff-uniform raw lower bound.
analytic_split.mean_proxy: The local value proxy exp[-t W_eps] has sqrt(t)z converging to a complex two-component Gaussian with rate h=9(a+2b+c), and t|z|^2 converges to Gamma(2,rate=h).
analytic_split.derivative_proxy: After exactly integrating independent local Gaussian derivatives, the rescaled factor is (1+2g|y|^2)^(-9/2), and t|z|^2 has density 35*g^2*r*(1+2*g*r)^(-9/2).
analytic_split.full_field_boundary: Neither local proxy is the spatially correlated full Gibbs measure; no full-field bare concentration theorem is inferred.
